acceptance_criteria: The skill must parse CSV text input safely
It must identify the specified column and compute the mode (most frequent value)
The output must be a dictionary with the key 'most_common_value' and the value being the mode
No external dependencies beyond Python standard library are allowed
objective: Read CSV text and return the most common value in a selected column

input.csv_text:
city,temperature
New York,75
Los Angeles,80
New York,70
Chicago,75
